mapper.select: SELECT ARM.A_IDX AS A_IDX, ARM.A_B_IDX A_B_IDX, ARM.A_RECEIVER_IDX AS A_RECEIVER_IDX, ARM.A_TYPE AS A_TYPE, ARM.A_URL AS A_URL, ARM.A_DATE AS A_DATE, ARM.A_READ AS A_READ, ARM.A_SENDER_IDX ASVA_SENDER_IDX, USR.U_NICNAME AS R_U_NAME, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, HUSR.U_NICNAME AS S_U_NAME FROM ALARM ARM JOIN USER USR ON USR.U_IDX = ARM.A_RECEIVER_IDX JOIN BOARD BRD ON BRD.B_IDX = ARM.A_B_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON HRT.H_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX LEFT JOIN USER HUSR ON HUSR.U_IDX = HRT.H_U_IDX WHERE A_RECEIVER_IDX = #{a_receiver_idx} AND A_READ = 'N' ORDER BY A_DATE DESC
